item.title: RBI to conduct 3-day Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on November 06, 2026
item.description:

Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, Maharashtra – Extension of Period
item.description:
The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, Maharashtra vide Directive No. NGP.DOS.SSM3.No.S611/5-04-166/2025-2026 dated November 06, 2025, for a period of six months up to close of business on May 07, 2026, which was last extended up to the close of business on November 07, 2026, vide Directive No. DOR.MON/D-30/12-22-635/2026-27 dated July 31, 2026. The Reserve Bank of India is satisfied that in the public interest, it is necessary to further extend the period of operation of the Directive beyond close of business on November 07, 2026.

2. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank of India, in the exercise of powers vested in it under sub-section (1) of Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, hereby extends the Directive for a further period of three months from close of business on November 07, 2026, to close of business on February 07, 2027, subject to review.

3. The aforesaid extension and /or modification by the Reserve Bank of India should not per se be construed to imply that the Reserve Bank of India is satisfied with the financial position of the bank.

4. Other terms and conditions of the Directive under reference, shall remain unchanged.

(Brij Raj)           
Chief General Manager

Press Release: 2026-2027/1446

item.title: Underwriting Auction for sale of Government Securities for ₹36,000 crore on November 06, 2026
item.description:
Government of India has announced the sale (re-issue) of Government Securities, as detailed below, through auction to be held on November 06, 2026 (Friday).

As per the extant scheme of underwriting commitment notified on November 14, 2007, the amounts of Minimum Underwriting Commitment (MUC) and the minimum bidding commitment under Additional Competitive Underwriting (ACU) auction, applicable to each Primary Dealer (PD), are as under:

(₹ crore)
Security Notified Amount MUC amount per PD Minimum bidding commitment per PD under ACU auction
7.06% GS 2041 23,000 548 548
7.43% GS 2076 13,000 310 310

The underwriting auction will be conducted through multiple price-based method on November 06, 2026 (Friday). PDs may submit their bids for ACU auction electronically through Reserve Bank of India’s Core Banking Solution (e-Kuber system) between 09:00 A.M. and 09:30 A.M. on the day of underwriting auction.

The underwriting commission will be credited to the current account of the respective PDs with RBI on the day of issue of securities.

Ajit Prasad          
Deputy General Manager
(Communications)    

Press Release: 2026-2027/1445
